Task:
You are a senior design director. Design direction #6: DESERT DUNE. Produce a complete, original visual design for the project below and write it to design-concepts/06-desert-dune/DESIGN.md, then generate ONE hero image (landscape, showing the chat UI in this style) via the image_gen tool if available, else an SVG mockup, saved as design-concepts/06-desert-dune/hero.svg (or hero.png if generated).

PROJECT: 'SHK Islam' - Arabic-first Islamic platform (RTL, lang=ar dir=rtl) for preachers/khatibs/students. Next.js 16 App Router + Tailwind v4 + shadcn/ui + next-themes (light/dark). The AI chat assistant is THE product: answers Islamic questions, cites Quran ayahs and hadiths via tool calls. REDESIGN GOAL: ChatGPT-style chat-first app. `/` = chat page. A collapsible sidebar holds the other pages (Quran browser, Hadith browser, Themes, Favorites, Search, About).

YOUR AESTHETIC SEED: warm sand neutrals, burnt-orange accent, sweeping minimal dune curves, maximum whitespace. Think minimalist desert architecture: smooth curved lines like wind-blown sand, warm sand tones from light dune to deep dusk, one burnt-orange accent. The chat feels calm, wide, and open like a desert horizon. Very high-end consumer calm with heavy whitespace (this is a low-density direction, luxury = emptiness).

GROUND RULES (non-negotiable): Zero em-dashes (— or –) in any copy/docs, use hyphen. Exactly ONE accent color (burnt-orange). One corner-radius system (large, soft, organic-feeling). min-h-[100dvh] never h-screen. RTL first: in dir=rtl the sidebar sits on the RIGHT visually (use the 'start' side). Calm motion: transform/opacity only, prefers-reduced-motion honored, no scroll-hijack, no marquee, curves via border-radius and SVG, never canvas. No AI-purple gradients. Tajawal stays as Arabic UI font. Recommend zero new dependencies.

DESIGN.md must contain, in order: (1) One-line Design Read, (2) 3-4 sentence concept narrative, (3) exact palette (light AND dark) with concrete color values for background, surface, primary accent, secondary, text, borders, (4) typography plan reusing Tajawal (generous line-height), (5) full layout system: chat shell wireframe (ASCII), collapsible sidebar treatment, whitespace discipline, (6) component inventory: chat input, message bubbles, tool callouts (ayah/hadith), sidebar nav items, empty state (open, spacious, suggested prompts), (7) motion spec, (8) corner radius + surface system, (9) 3 signature premium details unique to this direction, (10) anti-slop self-audit checklist confirming every ground rule.

Be opinionated and specific. Concrete values, not vibes. This is a real spec another engineer will implement.
